versions.title: Lights Out

skins.name: Starry Nightcap
skins.story: She falls asleep counting the yellow stars on her midnight pyjamas, and the pompom of her nightcap always ends up on her ear.

skins.name: Mint Stripe Pyjamas
skins.story: He has worn his mint striped pyjamas for three lazy days in a row, and his bed hair has stopped listening to the comb.

skins.name: Counting Sheep
skins.story: She counts sheep every night until she is the sheep, curled up in a woolly onesie with floppy grey ears.

versions.note: The lamps go off and three new sleepyheads shuffle into the pack: a stargazer in a drooping nightcap, a very tired pyjama fan and a little sheep who counts herself to sleep.

versions.title: Snow Day Knits

skins.name: Fair Isle Snowflake
skins.story: He was the first one out in the snow this morning, and his teal Fair Isle jumper still has a snowflake on the chest to prove it.

skins.name: Reindeer Jumper
skins.story: His grandma knitted a reindeer on his jumper and two antlers on his hood, and he has refused to take either off since.

skins.name: Hot Cocoa Argyle
skins.story: He drinks his hot cocoa so fast that he always wears a chocolate moustache under his fluffy earmuffs.

versions.note: School is snowed in, so the sleepers pull out their warmest winter knits: a Fair Isle jumper with a pompom beanie, a reindeer jumper with antlers and an argyle sweater with fluffy earmuffs.

versions.title: Sweet Dreams Club

skins.name: Patchwork Quilt
skins.story: She never got out of bed this winter, so her grandma simply stitched her favourite quilt into a hood and a onesie.

skins.name: Sleepy Panda
skins.story: He sleeps twenty hours a day in his panda onesie and still wakes up smiling, already looking forward to the next nap.

skins.name: Sweetheart Cardigan
skins.story: She knitted her pink cardigan heart by heart, and whenever she thinks of her warm bed her eyes turn into hearts too.

versions.note: The sleepers start a club for the best naps in the world: one wrapped in a patchwork quilt, a panda who snores in bubbles and a dreamer in a heart cardigan.
